comment: Wizard-mode Priest creates a kobold mummy, slays it with #wizkill, picks up the kobold corpse it leaves (which keeps the mummy's traits), and zaps a wished-for wand of undead turning at himself. zap.c unturn_dead() revives the carried corpse as a kobold mummy, a different type from the corpse, and names that type with mon_pmname(): "It suddenly reanimates as a kobold mummy!"
